title: Don't Call it a Brain in a Dish!

reader_summary.headline: Hi and welcome to the A16Z podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi and welcome to the A16Z podcast. I'm Hannah, and in this episode, General Partner Vijay Pande and I talk with Sergio Pashka, Professor of Behavioral Science at Stanford. So what are brain organoids, how were they developed, and how can we use them?

key_points.text: I'm Hannah, and in this episode, General Partner Vijay Pande and I talk with Sergio Pashka, Professor of Behavioral Science at Stanford.
key_points.evidence_quote: I'm Hannah, and in this episode, General Partner Vijay Pande and I talk with Sergio Pashka, Professor of Behavioral Science at Stanford, all about a new technology we have for understanding brain disorders, the wild and very sci-fi new frontier of brain organoids.
